Market today: Tech is still the main driver, but the broader market's showing some cracks with junk bonds flashing a warning. Your concentrated tech/chip book is feeling the heat.

Your holdings: CRWD (30.4%), QQQ (0.52%), SMCI (-26.85%), SNOW (-5.76%), MU (-30.63%), SOXL (-56.11%), SPAL (-35.9%), QQQI (-3.3%), SMH (-13.82%), SPY (4.37%), METU (6.39%), PLTU (3.36%), MSFU (0.67%). SMCI, MU, SOXL, SPAL, SNOW, CRWD, QQQ, QQQI, SMH are all marked SELL/TRIM and need attention. The leveraged ETFs (MU, SOXL, SPAL) and SMCI are particularly concerning given your margin.

Watch: Chip stocks are showing signs of life after a tough period, but the leveraged ETFs are still deep in the red.

Bottom line: Focus on managing your leveraged positions and the names marked for attention.
plays: Trim SOXL and MU if they show any strength; these leveraged ETFs are decay traps, especially on margin.
Consider trimming SMCI if it fails to hold its current level, given the significant loss.
No new buys today - hold and watch.
